verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own docs say it supports designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts, and its Feature Flags API assigns users to experiment variants. So a first-party A/B experiment capability exists. The evidence never mentions defining goal metrics or reporting statistical significance on results, so only the core experiment-running part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented goal-metric configuration for experiments, statistical significance reporting on results, an in-depth experiments report doc, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results

citations.quote: designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts in the same place you do all your analytics
Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
